QuestInfo.name: [Phantom Forest] Leader of the Corrupted Knights
QuestInfo.0: Taggrin has something to ask of you. Go see him.
QuestInfo.1: Taggrin tells you that Killian, one of the legendary masters of the ancient Crimsonwood Keep, has been revived. He asks you to stop Killian, saying that Killian will show himself if you defeat many of the elite knights who appear when you vanquish spirits in the forest.
QuestInfo.2: You defeated Killian and LeFay, who were threatening the Phantom Forest.

mob.0: Please stop him before he causes even more trouble.
